subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown the six faces of which are U, V, W, X, Y and Z. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'V'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57e421e850f2a77ed5dd37c91816af3e7690c5951e1b0b1d1607dc89e15f7b7c.png]
solution:
Let's check two different positions of the same dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4fe7cd4d5821181a92cd150d856da7bb67d335d12ecd510d8bbd32a0c9195d9.png] 

Here, two faces X and Y are common. ⇒ V is opposite to U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U"**.
